Iran Faces Political Infighting Amid Economic Woes and War

Iran is experiencing deepening political infighting as economic difficulties persist during wartime. Hardliners are increasing pressure on the government, demanding the removal of Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi. The oil minister has resigned, though this has not significantly eased the pressure on President Masoud Pezeshkian. Despite the ongoing war, currency crisis, and worsening economy, Iran's stock market has seen a surge.
